ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so my morning errand was a walk out to check on the hives for my neighbour. The bees were already busy in the dawn light, and the whole green smelled of clover. I wandered the hamlet on the way here, and I'm glad to be sharing the morning with you all.

bo.text: Um, hi. I'm Bo. This morning I planned to walk to the orchard with my flute. Then the plan changed, twice, and I ended up here instead. I think I like it. Maybe I'll play something for you later.
